Rito warriors favor it for its superior rate of fire, which helps them excel even further at aerial combat.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Bow |strength = 20 |durability = 50 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Falcon Bow}} Falcon Bows are highly refined [[Bow]]s made by master [[Rito]] craftsmen. These Bows belong to the [[Rito Gear]] equipment archetype.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 172}} They have a quick rate of fire, which Rito warriors favor for use in aerial combat. Falcon Bows are found both in [[Treasure Chest]]s and in the hands of [[Enemy|Enemies]] on the [[Tabantha Frontier]] and in the [[Hebra Mountains]]. During the "[[Divine Beast Vah Medoh (Quest)|Divine Beast Vah Medoh]]" [[Main Quest]], [[Teba]] will allow [[Link]] to take a Swallow Bow he has modified from a nearby Treasure Chest for their fight against [[Divine Beast Vah Medoh]].{{Cite|Inside that treasure chest is a {{Color BotW|Blue|bow}} I've modified. Take it, and let me know when you're ready.|Teba|BotW}} The following [[amiibo]] have a chance to spawn a Treasure Chest containing a Falcon Bow when they are scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]]: * {{BotW}} Series Link (Archer) amiibo * {{BotW|-}} Series [[Revali]] amiibo Being made of wood, Falcon Bows will burn if they are exposed to [[Fire]] or equipped in a [[Scorching Climate]]. In addition, they will float if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], and they will not conduct [[Electricity]] or attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s. Finally, they cannot be picked up with the [[Magnesis]] Rune. {{BotW Bow Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Bow_017" |Life = 50 |Power = 20 |Range = 40.0 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 5 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 9 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 6 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 11 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 10 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 16 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 12 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 28 |PoweredSharpAddSpreadFire = false |PoweredSharpAddZoomRapid = false |PoweredSharpAddRapidFireMin = 1.1 |PoweredSharpAddRapidFireMax = 1.3 |ArrowName = "" |IsLeadShot = false |LeadShotNum = 3 |LeadShotAng = 13.0 |IsRapidFire = false |RapidFireNum = 0 |ArrowGravity = -9.8 |ArrowChargeRate = 1.6 |ArrowReloadRate = 1.0 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Falcon Bow}} {{Stub|TotK}} {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Bow |strength = 14 |durability = |flammable = Yes |magnetic = |buoyant = Yes |conductive = |guardian = }} Falcon Bows appear in {{TotK}}. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Teba Weapon }} {{Stub|AoC}} The Falcon Bow is primarily used by [[Teba]]. When he arrives in the past, he uses it to shoot [[Arrow]]s at [[Windblight Ganon]]'s cannons to intercept its attack on [[Revali]].
